smc_lud.source_release: Figshare SMC-LUD archive, 1,328,048,074 bytes; publisher-reported MD5 03b28af94e37c4ae9b27024654aaf91e
smc_lud.usage_restriction: Non-commercial research use only according to the dataset record and source publication; follow the dataset terms and attribution requirements.
limitations: Source partitions do not match the manuscript partition counts.
Patient folders linked by image filename indicate source patients in multiple source partitions; the preparation command rejects patient leakage.
The exact manuscript patient assignment and clinical profiles are unavailable; a replacement partition is not the manuscript partition unless independently verified.
A deterministic patient token is derived from the class and original patient folder; these tokens are identifiers for partition checking, not proof of anonymization.
smc_lud.audit_command: python code/dataset_tool.py audit-smc DATA_ROOT --subset all --patients PATIENTS.csv
smc_lud.preparation_command: python code/dataset_tool.py prepare-smc DATA_ROOT --subset all --profiles PROFILES.csv --patient-split PATIENTS.csv --output DATA_ROOT/manifest.jsonl
smc_lud.patient_table: Audit exports patient, label, images and a blank split column; populate split with train, val or test based on an independently documented assignment.
smc_lud.profile_table: CSV columns image and text; image is the complete relative path under the data root, and exactly one profile from a documented source is required per image.

tcia.source_release: B-mode-and-CEUS-Liver version 2; source lists 120 subjects and DICOM images under CC BY 4.0 with data citation required.
tcia.selection_table: CSV next to or above the DICOM files with columns image, patient, frame, label, text, b_mode_confirmed. Image is a relative path, frame is zero-based, label is 1 for HCC and 0 otherwise, and b_mode_confirmed must be yes.
limitations: The manuscript's 118-subject, 583-frame selection and frame-level labels have not been supplied or independently reconstructed.
The B-mode confirmation and reference diagnosis must be established from source metadata or reviewed annotations; the code does not infer them from an unspecified mechanical-index threshold.

Only single-channel DICOM frames are supported. A per-frame linear min-max conversion to 8-bit is an engineering default not specified by the manuscript; color frames are rejected and dual-panel images require manual review.
No TCIA DICOM instance or exact manuscript selection was available for verification.

chulabhorn.access: The paper describes data available on request; source files and selection metadata have not been provided.

clinical_profiles.reason: The paper does not provide the joint sampling distributions, translations, or image-profile assignments.
